questions.question: In a certain code language, 'YACHT' is coded as '8' and 'SHALEOD' is coded as '24'. How will 'ANALYSTIC' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (Number of the letters within the word - 4) × 8 

So,

 
• 'YACHT' is coded as '8'

Number of the letters in the given word is '5' i.e Y, A, C, H and T.

⇒ (5 - 4) × 8

⇒ 1 × 8

⇒ 8

And,

 
• 'SHALEOD' is coded as '24'

Number of the letters in the given word is '7' i.e S, H, A, L, E, O and D.

⇒ (7 - 4) × 8

⇒ 3 × 8

​⇒ 24

​Similarly,

 
• 'ANALYSTIC' is coded as :

Number of the letters in the given word is '9' i.e A, N, A, L, Y, S, T, I and C.

⇒ (9 - 4) × 8

⇒ 5 × 8

​⇒** 40**

​Hence, "40" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?

(1) 4 - 125

(2) 3 - 64

(3) 2 - 8

(4) 6 - 343
questions.solution:
Logic : Cube of (1st number +1) = 2nd number

​​So,​

__
 
• (1) : 4 - 125

​(4 + 1)³ = 125

(5)³ = 125

125 = 125 (LHS = RHS)

 
• (2) : 3 - 64

​(3 + 1)³ = 64

(4)³ = 64

64 = 64 (LHS = RHS)

 
• (3) : 2 - 8

​(2 + 1)³ = 8

(3)³ = 8

**27 ≠ 8 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

 
• (4) : 6 - 343

​(6 + 1)³ = 343

(7)³ = 343

343 = 343 (LHS = RHS)

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__** **The given options are not in sequence wise, so mark the answer carefully.**
